title: Customers
description: Manage your customer list, view purchase history, and export data.

rowActions.copyStripeCustomerIdMissingToast: This customer has no Stripe customer ID
rowActions.copyStripeCustomerIdToast: Stripe customer ID copied to clipboard
rowActions.deleteAdminHint: Remove the admin access in Settings › Team first.
rowActions.deleteDescription: This action cannot be undone. We will delete the account of {name} ({email}) with their profile, saved addresses, wishlist, newsletter subscription, sign-in history, activity log, and their customer profile and saved cards at Stripe. Their orders and payments stay in the accounting records for 5 years, as the law requires. We will send the customer an account-deletion confirmation email.

toast.cannotDeleteAdminDescription: Admin accounts cannot be deleted. Remove the admin access in Settings › Team first.
toast.cannotDeleteSelfDescription: You cannot delete your own account from this view.
toast.deleteEmailFailedDescription: The confirmation email to the customer could not be sent. The error is recorded in the audit log.
toast.deleteErrorDescription: The customer account could not be deleted. Please try again.
toast.deleteNotFoundDescription: This customer was not found. Refresh the table and try again.
toast.deleteSuccessDescription: The account was deleted and a confirmation email was sent.
toast.deleteStripeCustomerFailedDescription: Stripe could not delete the customer's profile and saved cards, so the account was not deleted. Try again in a few minutes. The error is recorded in the audit log.
